race.description: 1 Equine - For The Equine Athlete Hcp (Bm60)
race.comment: LADY WILLPOWER (9) followed up a strong win as the favourite at Dalby with a solid run for third at the Gold Coast 3 weeks ago. She cops a tough gate, but does slide down slightly in class, and is good enough to take this out. EVERYWHERE (8) has only been fair since winning here by a head second up for the season in August. He has a good draw, and perhaps the drop in trip from 1350m to 1200m, can help him bounce back into some good form. ULUWATU (4) races well on her home course, and she was up in class when failing to fire at the Sunshine Coast last time out. She can make amends in this, so stick with her. HEROIC CHIEF (1) is a durable veteran who has been mixing his form, His record here on his home track is normally consistent, and he is worth including in all top 4 combos. KINGSLAND (3) is closing in on another win, and he will be dropping back in trip after his last start third over 1500m at Warwick a month ago. He has won twice over this distance in the past, and win this.
